div.div:
last declaration wins. compile_tags_in_version walks from the end; the first statement seen per name is kept, delete name; consumes
the name.
an example
root v0 currency = EUR · Apple v0 price = 3 · Apple v1 price = 4
compiled Apple v0: currency = EUR, price = 3
compiled Apple v1: currency = EUR (copied from the root), price = 4
